Given the sphere (x+1)2+(y−3)2+(z+3)2=3, what is the domain of z=z(x,y)?

a
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius 9 centered at (−1,3)
b
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius 3 centered at (1,−3)
c
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius 3 centered at (−3,1)
d
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius 3 centered at (−1,3)
e
The interior and boundary of the circle of radius 3 centered at (−3,1)
